literal_meaning: পাঁচটি ভূত বা পঞ্চভূত (পৃথিবী, জল, অগ্নি, বায়ু, আকাশ)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখন পাঁচভূতেরা সব জানতে চায় কী হচ্ছে।
পাঁচভূতের মতো সাধারণ লোকেরা এসব ব্যাপারে কিছু বোঝে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Now the ordinary people want to know what's happening.
Common folk like the five elements don't understand such matters.
history: Derived from the ancient Indian philosophical concept of Panchabhuta, the five great elements in Hindu cosmology, adapted idiomatically in Bengali to refer to everyday people.
note: The idiom plays on the idea of the five elements encompassing all ordinary existence.
